note: Provenance for first-party (derived) skills — the counterpart to skills-lock.json. skills-lock.json is tool-owned (npx skills) and tracks VENDORED verbatim copies; this file is HAND-owned and tracks skills we authored by adapting or drawing on outside sources. The npx skills tool never touches this file. Each source is tracked independently: `relationship` decides sync behavior; `ref` is the upstream commit this skill is reconciled through as of `reviewed`. INITIAL PINS are baselines set to current upstream HEAD on the import date — they mean 'watch from here', not 'verified byte-identical to that commit'. To surface divergence that predates the baseline, run a one-time diff (see the drift-check step).

relationships.adapted: Forked from the source, then intentionally diverged. Has a `ref`. Sync = 3-way reconcile (diff ref..HEAD, port non-conflicting changes, then bump `ref`+`reviewed`). Never overwrite.
relationships.spec: Conforms to an external normative specification rather than forking code. Watch the spec `url`/version; reconcile when the spec revises.
relationships.inspired-by: Ideas, structure, or terminology only — no code lineage. Attribution only; the drift checker skips these (no `ref`).

Recorded retroactively. Commit b6c9cd4 states the adaptation ('Adapted from thoughtbot's rails-consultant skills') and deliberately kept it out of skills-lock.json, but no provenance entry replaced it — the same gap 48e467f found for explain. Reconciled through this ref: upstream's 'what already exists' grounding note and its sharper Socratic warning are ported; its /code-review --fix instruction is deliberately not, since this payload's code-review is a first-party skill that reports rather than fixes.

Recorded retroactively. Commit 860c1ea states the adaptation and the audience-aware Step 0 that diverged from it, but added no provenance entry. INITIAL PIN — a baseline to watch from, not a verified reconcile. Diverged further on 2026-08-23: the rewrite to the agent-skills spec added Gotchas, Troubleshooting, references/ (FORMATS, QUESTIONS, GATHER), fill-in skeletons under assets/, a draft-never-send rule for outward-facing text, cadence handling (spoken standups and the end-of-week variant the description already promised), multi-repo and tracker gathering keyed off the optional ~/.agents/CONTEXT.md, a citation to this payload's own AGENTS.md §8 for voice, and a per-audience journal at ~/.agents/standup/ that makes each run a continuity check against the last update to the same reader (new: mac creates and links the directory, all three clients grant write to it, and .gitignore keeps the entries out of history). Upstream at this ref is byte-identical to the pinned copy, so there was nothing to port; the local divergence is not a reconcile and the ref is unchanged.

Upstream moved to round-based questioning (ask the whole dependency frontier per round); this fork keeps one-question-at-a-time deliberately, and `triage` relies on that. Reconciled at 85f83d3: the only SKILL.md changes since 84fdeff were em-dash removal and a horizontal rule in the round template, both house-style conflicts with nothing to port. The failure modes documented in upstream's docs/productivity/grilling.md were drawn on for Gotchas and Troubleshooting.

Recorded retroactively — the origin source. Commit b6c9cd4 added this skill 'adapted from thoughtbot's rails-consultant skills' and made it framework-agnostic; the mattpocock and obra sources below were folded in later by 9e10c0e. Diverged on 2026-08-23: the rewrite to the agent-skills spec restructured the body into ## Workflows, added references/ (RUNNERS, WALKTHROUGH), consumed the $ARGUMENTS the argument-hint had always promised, rewrote the description around the phrases the trigger eval actually uses, scoped the Iron Law to code written in-session and added the characterization-test path for untested legacy code, promoted the green baseline from a gotcha to workflow step 1, added runner discovery and the failure-vs-error distinction that 'one change, one run' depends on, dropped obra's 'ask your partner' framing, and replaced the dangling 'rspec skill' handoff with rules/rspec.md, which is a path-scoped rule and auto-loads. That divergence is local, not a reconcile. Separately, drift-checked the same day: upstream HEAD is still 9807306, so this source has not moved since the pin and the INITIAL PIN caveat no longer applies — nothing to port, ref unchanged, reviewed bumped.

Reconciled 84fdeff..5b15a47. The whole delta at this path is house-style: em dashes replaced with colons throughout, and '/codebase-design skill' rephrased as 'call the Skill tool with codebase-design'. Both conflict with conventions this payload holds deliberately — em dashes are house voice, and invocation phrasing is governed by check-payload's handoff-invocability check — so there was nothing to port. Same conclusion grilling reached at 85f83d3 against the same upstream.

Reconciled 44c9b2d..b36e082. The range touches 40 files upstream but not skills/test-driven-development, so the diff at this path is empty — nothing to port. This pin now matches git-worktree, fan-out, and brainstorming, which were already reconciled through b36e082.
